quote: Decompilation, the reverse process of converting machine code or binary code into a high-level programming language, facilitates various reverse engineering tasks... Recent advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) have greatly improved the process of decompiling code.
Researchers have reformulated decompilation as a translation exercise, converting machine-level instructions into readable source code.
We propose LLM4Decompile, the first and largest open-source LLM series with sizes ranging from 1.3B to 33B parameters specifically trained to decompile binary code.
As for the evaluation metrics, we follow previous work to calculate the re-executability rate... we access the readability of decompiled results in terms of Edit Similarity score.
